title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**About Telnyx**
*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a*

We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.*
**The Role**
We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Bangalore — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.
  
  
This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.
  
  
You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.
  
  
*The Pod Model*
*Enterprise AE*
— owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.
  
  
*Forward Deployed Engineer*
— owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
  
  
We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
* Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
* Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like BharatGPT, OpenHathi, or other Indic-language sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
* Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
* Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
* Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
* Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
* Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
* Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for English and Indic language use cases (Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, and other regional languages) and India-specific regulatory environments (DPDP Act, data localization, RBI cloud regulations)
* Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
* Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
* Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from India
* Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

**What We're Looking For**

* CS degree or equivalent experience
* 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
* Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
* Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
* Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
* You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
* High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
* You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency
* Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts
* Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems
* Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own
* Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week
* Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause
* Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across India
* Legally authorized to work in India, or eligible for sponsorship

*Bonus Points For*

* Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems
* Building eval sets for a specific domain
* Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management
* Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including Indic-language models (BharatGPT, OpenHathi, Bhashini, Sarvam AI) and Indian sovereign AI initiatives
* Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)
* SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)
* ETL and data wrangling experience
* CI/CD pipeline design and automation
* Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS
* Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and Indian regulatory frameworks (DPDP Act, data localization under IT Rules, RBI cloud and data residency requirements, MeitY AI governance guidelines)
* Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)

title: Director - Private Markets Data Services
description:

The eFront Insight business, a part of Aladdin, is a fast-growing part of BlackRock’s Private Markets technology strategy, focused on building a best-in-class Private Markets Data and Analytical platform. **Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. title: AI Platform Administrator

**Administration**

* Manage model installation, version upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management for all self-hosted AI models.

* Define and enforce governance policies for AI/LLM usage, including acceptable use, data handling, and access approval workflows.

* Maintain documentation of usage policies, entitlements, renewal dates, and compliance requirements for each LLM.
* Partner with Finance to forecast, budget, and optimize spend on paid LLM subscriptions.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT policies, data protection regulations, and applicable AI governance standards.

User Enablement and Training

* Deliver training sessions and internal communications to drive awareness and responsible use of AI tools.
* Serve as the first point of contact for end-user questions on licensing, access, and platform capabilities.

* Recommend and drive process improvements, automation, and tooling to streamline LLM administration and governance.
* Evaluate emerging LLM platforms and tools and provide recommendations on adoption or migration.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of overall IT administration and systems/application administration experience, including at least 4 years focused on AI/ML platform management.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience managing self-hosted or offline LLM deployment and paid/commercial LLM platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini).
* Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps for provisioning workflows.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for hosting offline models.
* Proficient scripting skills (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for automation of monitoring and reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems**
Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales-led motion and a product-led self-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. We're hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.
  
  
The Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems is the senior platform expert across Quickbase's billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role owns day-to-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual-motion SaaS environment, currently anchored on BillingPlatform and Stripe, with the platform landscape expected to evolve. As the senior-most administrator on the team, this role also carries a higher bar for platform strategy, complex problem-solving, and mentorship of other billing systems administrators.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
***Billing Systems Administration***

* Own multiple billing platform administration for both our product-led self-serve motion and sales-led enterprise grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling
* Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly
* Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time
* Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices
* Serve as the primary Stripe and enterprise billing platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team
* Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly
* Lead the evaluation, planning, and execution of billing platform changes and migrations, and serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for the most complex billing systems issues

***Quote-to-Cash Integrations***

* Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote-to-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems
* Support CPQ-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract-to-subscription linkages
* Configure and test PLG self-serve billing flows for new product launches, pricing changes, free trial conversion logic, and self-serve subscription management
* Proactively identify quote-to-cash risks and dependencies across billing, CPQ, and provisioning systems, and drive resolution ahead of launches and pricing changes

***Provisioning Connectivity***

* Partner with Product Engineering on the billing-to-provisioning handoff across both PLG self-serve and SLG enterprise motions
* Maintain the billing-side integration touchpoints that connect Stripe and our enterprise billing platform to provisioning workflows, ensuring subscription and order events carry the right data for downstream customer access
* Monitor the billing-to-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access
* Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side
* Lead root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact billing-to-provisioning failures and drive the resulting process or configuration improvements to closure

***Data Quality & Reconciliation***

* Run regular data quality checks across billing systems: subscriber data, payment records, invoice history, and subscription states across SLG and PLG customers
* Support billing reconciliation across our enterprise billing platform, Stripe, Avalara, and NetSuite
* Support month-end and quarter-end close with clean, complete, defensible data for Finance reporting
* Maintain runbooks and escalation documentation for common billing data issues
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to other billing systems administrators, and contribute to team-wide best practices, standards, and documentation

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in billing systems administration, revenue operations, or SaaS billing in environments serving both enterprise and self-serve customers, including experience operating as the senior-most or lead administrator on a billing systems team
* Deep hands-on experience with Stripe: subscription management, payment processing, webhook configuration, dunning configuration, and PLG billing flows
* Hands-on experience with an enterprise subscription billing platform (e.g., BillingPlatform, Revenue Cloud, Zuora, Chargebee) — depth on any one of these matters more than tenure on a specific platform
* Development skills in building automation workflows in billing systems via API, webhooks, and other workflow configurations
* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ: quote-to-cash process, price book structure, and integration touchpoints with billing systems
* Familiarity with billing-to-provisioning integration patterns and partnership with product engineering teams on subscription event propagation
* Experience supporting billing reconciliation with Finance through NetSuite or equivalent ERP
* Experience in B2B SaaS environments with both sales-led and product-led revenue motions
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional billing initiatives and mentoring less experienced administrators

**Preferred**

Working across Basis, Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Project Delivery, Service Management and business teams, you will lead landscape planning, environment usage, system availability, refresh cycles, release alignment and technical change control. You will also chair SAP landscape, release, change and environment governance forums.
  
  
This role is key to ensuring the SAP landscape supports both operational needs and strategic transformation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Own and maintain the SAP landscape strategy, including development, test, quality assurance, pre-production, training, sandbox, and production environments.
  
  
Lead SAP environment roadmap and ensures landscapes are available and fit for purpose for projects, releases, testing, upgrades, integrations, and business-as-usual support.
  
  
Coordinate landscape demand from projects, programmes, and operational teams, resolving conflicts around environment usage, system availability, freeze periods, and refresh schedules.
  
  
Maintain a clear view of SAP system dependencies, interfaces, data flows, and environment relationships. Ensure landscape decisions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, operational resilience, and business continuity requirements.
  
  
Oversee the operational health of the SAP landscape to ensure service stability. Govern system availability, performance, capacity, technical risks, and recurring operational issues. Orchestrate incident, problem, and change activities affecting the SAP landscape, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and communication.
  
  
Ensure operational documentation, system inventories, support models, ownership matrices, and critical issue paths are maintained.
  
  
Accountable for planning and coordination of system refreshes, client copies, environment rebuilds, system provisioning, and decommissioning activities. Coordinate technical readiness for SAP releases, upgrades, migrations, enhancement packages, support packs, kernel updates, and major project deployments.
  
  
Work with delivery teams to ensure development, test, and production environments are aligned to release and testing requirements. Lead environment freeze windows, transport routes, retrofit considerations, sequencing, and dependency impacts.
  
  
Support cutover planning and technical dress rehearsals for major SAP changes.
  
  
Ensure SAP landscape follows security, audit, regulatory, and internal control requirements. Work closely with SAP Security and GRC teams to ensure environment access, segregation of duties, privileged access, and sensitive data usage are appropriately governed.
  
  
Ensure non-production systems are in synch with data protection, masking, retention, and access control standards.
  
  
Act as the central point of coordination for SAP landscape matters across IT, business, project, and supplier teams. Provide clear communication on landscape availability, risks, constraints, dependencies, and planned changes.
  
  
Work with third-party vendors, service providers, and internal teams to ensure service levels are met.
  
  
**Required Skills And Experience**

* 4 to 8 years of solid experience working in complex SAP environments, ideally across multiple SAP products and integrated systems. Should have led landscape demand across projects, programmes, and business-as-usual operations.
* Good understanding of SAP landscape architecture across production and non-prod environments.
* Experience coordinating SAP Basis, infrastructure, database, cloud, security, and application teams.
* Knowledge of SAP transport management, release cycles, system refreshes, client copies, upgrades, patching, and technical change control.
* Good understanding of IT service management processes, including change, release, problem and configuration management.
* Strong risk management, governance, planning, and documentation skills.

**“Nice To Have” Skills And Experience**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, SAP Solution Manager, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP GRC, SAP BW/Datasphere or SAP Enterprise Portal.
* Experience with cloud-hosted SAP landscapes, for example AWS, Google Cloud, RISE with SAP, or private cloud environments!

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary functional and administrative point of contact for Workday, supporting HR, Finance, Customer Experience, Partner Operations, and Go-To-Market teams.
* Investigate issues related to Workday business processes, security groups, condition rules, reports, calculated fields, workflows, approval steps, and data visibility.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve Workday-related support tickets within agreed SLA timelines, and support users with how-to queries, troubleshooting, and process guidance.
* Collaborate with Workday admins/HRIS teams, QA, business stakeholders, and technical teams to resolve complex or recurring Workday issues.
* Support Workday system enhancements, feature rollouts, process changes, testing activities, and business adoption.
* Extend support as needed across other business platforms, including NetSuite (access, approvals, finance workflows), Boomi integrations (initial issue analysis and coordination with technical teams), and Partner Portal (access and visibility support).
* Maintain SOPs, FAQs, resolution notes, knowledge articles, and support documentation, with a primary focus on Workday.
* Identify support trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across Workday and other platforms, and recommend improvements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in business systems support, application support, or IT support operations, with a strong focus on Workday.
* Hands-on experience supporting Workday (HCM, Core HR, or related modules) in a production environment — this is a core requirement for the role.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security groups, condition rules, calculated fields, and reporting.
* Experience working with ticketing tools such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of incident management, SLA-based support, prioritization, and escalation handling.
* Ability to troubleshoot user issues, identify root causes, and provide clear resolutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced support environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Good to Have
  
  

* Familiarity with Workday integration tools such as EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, or reporting (RaaS) from a functional support perspective.
* Workday Pro certification (e.g., HCM, Core Compensation, Absence, or Security) or similar Workday certification.
* Experience supporting teams across HR, Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Partner Operations, Support, or Go-To-Market functions.
* Exposure to other business platforms such as NetSuite, Boomi, Partner Portal, ERP systems, or other HRIS/finance platforms.
* General understanding of integrations from a functional support perspective.
* Experience creating SOPs, support documentation, knowledge articles, and user training material.
* Experience supporting UAT, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate is a Workday expert first — someone with strong Workday functional and admin knowledge who can own Workday support end-to-end, from business process configuration to security, reporting, and troubleshooting. They should also be comfortable extending that support to other business platforms as needed, understanding business impact, communicating clearly with users, coordinating with technical teams, and contributing to continuous improvement across support operations.
